fullDescription: A high-end 3D immersive scroll experience with a 'Museum' or 'Journey' aesthetic. Features cinematic depth transitions (Z-axis scrolling), editorial typography pairing a clean sans-serif with an elegant serif, and a luxurious dark mode palette with gold accents. Ideal for portfolios, storytelling, historical timelines, or luxury product showcases requiring a spatial, 3D hallway feel.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated 3D scroll-based UI where content frames are arranged in a deep spatial hallway. As the user scrolls, they 'walk' through the 3D space. The design uses heavy depth of field, perspective transforms, and high-contrast dark surfaces with gold highlights.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design style with a deep black background (#000) and a subtle radial gradient at (50% 40%) from #0d0d0d to #000. Incorporate a luxury gold accent (#D4AF37) for highlights and badges. Typography: Titles in 'Gambetta' serif (tracking-tight), body and UI in 'General Sans'. Use a 3D perspective of 2400px. Elements should have subtle borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.04)) and deep, multi-layered box shadows (0 4px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.9)). Implement a floor glow using a linear gradient to top from rgba(212,175,55,0.02) to transparent. Use ambient particles created via tiny radial gradients (1px) in gold and white with low opacity (0.03 to 0.15).

## Layout e Estrutura

### 3D Viewport & Track
The main container must have perspective: 2400px and perspective-origin: 50% 50%. Inside, a 'hallway-track' div uses transform-style: preserve-3d. Navigation is controlled by translateZ transforms. As the user scrolls, the hallway-track moves along the Z-axis from 0px to 3500px.

### Art Frames (3D Content)
Dimensions: 260px width, 380px height. Placement: 'top: 27%' to provide symmetrical vertical breathing room. Left-side frames: rotateY(35deg). Right-side frames: rotateY(-35deg). Spacing: frames are placed in pairs every 700px along the Z-axis (e.g., 0px, -700px, -1400px, -2100px, -2800px). Frames have a 1px border (rgba(255,255,255,0.04)) and a hover effect that increases brightness to 1.35 and adds a gold outer glow (0 0 40px rgba(212,175,55,0.15)).

### Information Modal (PIP Window)
A fixed overlay with backdrop-blur-md (40px) and a black/90 background. The central card is max-w-4xl, bg-zinc-950/95, with a thin border (zinc-800/60). Content includes: A gold badge (text-xs, tracking-widest, uppercase), a serif H2 title (Gambetta), and a 2-column image gallery with rounded-xl corners. The modal appears with a translateY(30px) to 0 transition and a scale(0.96) to 1 pop.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### 3D Art Frame — The core interactive unit of the experience.
A 260x380px rectangular frame with overflow-hidden and border-radius: 4px. Inside, an image with object-fit: contain and opacity: 0.85. On hover: image scale(1.03) and opacity: 1. Frame should exhibit a transition: filter 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease. It acts as a trigger for the detailed modal view.

### Gold Journey Badge — Chronological or category indicator.
An inline-block badge with px-3, py-1. Background: gold/10. Border: gold/20. Text: #D4AF37, size: 10px-12px, font-weight: 600, uppercase, tracking-widest. Used inside the modal to denote dates or categories.
